en.title: Prepare meetings from Notion
en.description: Build agendas and pre-reads from relevant Notion context.
tasks: Build agendas and pre-reads from relevant Notion context.
prerequisites: Notion MCP access to relevant project pages; research tools for external context.
en.example: Use notion-meeting-intelligence. Prepare a 30-minute project review agenda using these Notion pages and list unresolved decisions.
en.expectedResult: A timed agenda, linked pre-read, and questions matched to meeting goals.
limitations: Attendee context and private workspace material must be supplied through authorized access.
Upstream Codex connector setup commands are version-specific; use your current host’s Notion connection settings.

zh.title: 使用 Notion 准备会议
zh.description: 根据相关 Notion 内容准备议程和会前阅读材料。
tasks: 根据相关 Notion 内容准备议程和会前阅读材料。
prerequisites: Notion MCP 可访问相关项目页；外部背景研究需要研究工具。
zh.example: 请使用 notion-meeting-intelligence：根据这些 Notion 页面准备 30 分钟项目复盘议程，列出待定决策。
zh.expectedResult: 带时间安排的议程、会前阅读链接和对应会议目标的问题。
limitations: 参会人背景和私有工作区材料需要有授权的访问。
上游 Codex 连接配置命令有版本差异，请使用当前宿主的 Notion 连接设置。
